text:
tara: quick ping  we onboarded zenith11b-int6 yesterday. can someone give a one-paragraph GTN-ready econ + a single-line traffic recommendation (green/amber/red)?

ben: perf/econ snapshot: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~230ms on our T4 pool (cold). warmed-kv + prefix warmstart we expect ~20% lower latency. unit numbers (ballpark):
```
cost_per_token: $0.00063
avg_tokens_per_req: 320
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.20
tokens_saved_vs_int8: ~24%
estimated_latency_gain_with-warm-kv: -20% p95
```

sophie: quality quick notes: overall BLEU/ROUGE roughly similar for short-form; we see a reproducible drop in multi-document citation recall and an uptick in hallucinated facts on instruction-style prompts when context > 1500 tokens. examples in the eval deck.

ben: ops tradeoff idea: hybrid routing by predicted "longform-risk" score. route low-risk requests to int6; if risk > 0.6, fall back to fp16 variant. estimate: fallback hit ~12% -> cost delta ~+8% overall but preserves extraction recall.

tara: product needs a crisp sentence for GTN and a recommended rollout flag.

sophie: proposed one-liner: "Zenith11b-int6 delivers ~24% token-cost reduction with comparable short-form quality; recommend amber — enable for chat/RAG with hybrid routing and fp16 fallback for high longform-risk requests until we validate priming/ensemble mitigations."

ben: addendum: if product wants aggressive cost-first option, we can run a 10% chat-only rollout (green for chat) but keep summarizers/extractors off-path.

ops-bot: creating canary ticket: zenith11b-int6 -> 2026-07-15T08:00Z, A: 5% chat routes (warm-kv: true), B: hybrid-routing experiment with fp16 fallback (fallback-threshold=0.6), region: us-central-1. :white_check_mark:

tara: perfect. sophie, please attach the slice examples and the 3 mitigation hypotheses. ben, capture cost simulation with fallback percentages. we'll brief GTN with these bullets later today. :thumbsup:
